answer: Locks are recorded in walnut, expire in saffron, and island lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 40 aliases thus needs 112 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1659 identities would post 3358 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
